title: SAFEST Mobile App
shortDesc: Award-winning personal safety app for women with real-time emergency features.
longDesc: SAFEST (Sexual Assault Free Environment with Smart Technology) is a mobile safety app for women built with Flutter and Firebase. Features include real-time live video streaming with location sharing, SOS button, fake call simulator, emergency siren, text-to-speech accessibility, and safety education modules. Led as Team Leader for the national PKM-KC programme and won the Gold Award at the CSIT-UPM International iFYP Exhibition & Competition 2026.

title: AnimVerse
shortDesc: Anime discovery app with Firebase auth, Jikan API, and cloud favourites.
longDesc: AnimVerse is a Flutter mobile app that lets users explore thousands of anime titles, search by title, filter by genre, and save favourites to a personal cloud list. Integrates Jikan API (MyAnimeList) for anime data and Firebase for authentication and real-time Firestore storage. Features include Google Sign-In, paginated browsing, real-time favourites with user-scoped security rules, and full profile management.

title: Orbit Share
shortDesc: Full-featured cloud storage platform with file sharing, permissions, and analytics.
longDesc: DewaDrive is a mini Google Drive built with PHP and MySQL. Features include user authentication, folder and file management, multi-file upload, file preview (PDF, Office, XLSX), public and private sharing with per-folder permissions, role-based access (viewer/editor) with inheritance, S3-compatible storage, quota management, admin audit logs, analytics dashboard, and email notifications with daily digest. To access the website, please visit here: https://s.id/aplikasi_orbitshare

title: Image Encryption Website
shortDesc: Web app for encrypting and decrypting images using cryptography algorithms.
longDesc: A cryptography-focused web application that allows users to encrypt and decrypt image files directly in the browser. Demonstrates practical implementation of cryptographic principles in a web environment, with a focus on secure data handling and clean user interface. Built with PHP and JavaScript.

title: SAFEST UI/UX Design & Prototype
shortDesc: High-fidelity UI/UX design focused on emergency accessibility and intuitive safety features.
longDesc: Designed a high-fidelity interactive prototype for SAFEST, focusing on 'Urgent Accessibility' for users in high-stress situations. The design prioritizes one-handed navigation, high-contrast visual cues, and a calming aesthetic to assist users during emergencies. Key design challenges included creating an intuitive flow for the Fake Call simulator and ensuring the SOS button is instantly reachable. Built using Figma, the project includes a comprehensive design system, user flow mapping, and interactive transitions to simulate real-world usage.

title: Trash Warrior: Eco-Adventure
shortDesc: An educational 2D action game focused on environmental awareness and waste management.
longDesc: Trash Warrior is an interactive game developed to promote environmental literacy through engaging gameplay. Players take on the role of a 'warrior' tasked with collecting and sorting different types of waste while navigating challenging levels. Built with a focus on smooth mechanics and educational impact, the game implements real-time collision detection, dynamic score systems, and progressive difficulty levels. This project demonstrates the integration of game logic with meaningful real-world themes to create an impactful user experience.

title: TemuUsaha: Business Collaboration Platform
shortDesc: A strategic networking platform connecting entrepreneurs with investors and business partners.
longDesc: TemuUsaha is a digital ecosystem designed to bridge the gap between SMEs (UMKM) and potential investors. The UI/UX focuses on professional credibility and seamless networking, featuring a sophisticated business matching system, investment dashboards, and collaborative workspaces. I designed the interface with a clean, trustworthy aesthetic to foster professional trust, while optimizing the user flow for partnership pitching and progress tracking. The project involved deep user research, information architecture planning, and high-fidelity prototyping to ensure a streamlined experience for both entrepreneurs and funders.

title: Student Enrollment System
shortDesc: Full-stack university portal with course enrollment, payments, and timetable.
longDesc: A database-driven university student portal built with ASP.NET (C#) and Microsoft SQL Server as a group project at INTI International University. Features include secure session-based authentication, course enrollment and add/drop with history tracking, personalised timetable viewer, online payment with invoice generation, teaching evaluation, enquiry system, and full profile management. Built with a 3-tier architecture: HTML/CSS/JS frontend, ASP.NET business logic, and SQL Server data layer.
